_howto: Each look: { name, color (yellow|red|cyan|magenta|blue|green|ink|ink-dim), file (graded export), base (Rec.709 input for hold-to-compare), desc (optional caption) }. These are four DIFFERENT shots, so each look carries its OWN base. Top-level 'base' stays empty (it is only the shared fallback when every look uses the same frame). Drop the matching -rec709.jpg files into this folder to light up hold-to-compare.
